boot.name: Ferry
boot.slashDescription: Continue this conversation on another provider
boot.pillTitlePick: Pick another agent to continue this conversation
boot.pillTitleIdle: Continue this conversation with another agent

message.default: Continue from where the previous agent left off. If that work is already finished, briefly summarize where things stand and wait for my next instruction.

picker.noAgent: Open Ferry from an agent's chat: type /ferry, or find Ferry in the Command Center (⌘K).
picker.chooseHint: Pick a provider to see how it would take over.
picker.explainNative: {label} reads the same session store: it continues the very same session, with every message, tool result and thought. Nothing is summarized. This agent is archived.

explainBack.one: Goes back to the {label} agent that had this conversation earlier. Its own context is still there; it gets only the {count} item it missed.
explainBack.other: Goes back to the {label} agent that had this conversation earlier. Its own context is still there; it gets only the {count} items it missed.

explainNativeBack.one: Picks up the earlier session on {label} natively and sends it the {count} item it missed.
explainNativeBack.other: Picks up the earlier session on {label} natively and sends it the {count} items it missed.

picker.explainHandoff: Starts a new {label} agent and hands it the conversation's history, chosen to fit a budget. Your message bubble shows only what you write.
picker.fresh: Start a new agent instead (hand over the whole history)
picker.messagePlaceholder: Optional: by default it continues where the last agent stopped
picker.messagePlaceholderNative: Optional: leave empty to switch without sending anything
picker.previewNothing: No history is sent this time.
picker.cannotOpen: This app version cannot open agents from here; find it in the sidebar.

result.doneHandoff: Handed over to {to}: {selected} of {total} items sent.

doneBack.one: Back on {to}, with the {count} item it missed.
doneBack.other: Back on {to}, with the {count} items it missed.

doneNativeBack.one: Continued the earlier session on {to}, with the {count} item it missed.
doneNativeBack.other: Continued the earlier session on {to}, with the {count} items it missed.

result.doneNativeRestored: The earlier {to} agent is back, on the same session.

rows.limit: It looks like the quota is used up.
rows.limitReset: It looks like the quota is used up; it resets at {time}.
rows.limitResetGuessed: It looks like the quota is used up; it resets around {time}.
rows.replyConnection: The provider could not be reached; the reply is its error.
rows.replyError: The reply is an error from the provider.

sent.intro: This is the history text the agent received with the handoff (not shown in the message bubble).
sent.gone: This handoff's text is no longer kept (it may be past the retention period).

errors.nothingToMove: This agent has no conversation yet, so there is nothing to hand over.
errors.chooseTarget: Choose a provider to continue on (or set a partner for this provider in the settings).
errors.sameProvider: This conversation is already on {label}. Choose another of its models to start a new {label} agent with the history; to change the model in place, use the model picker by the composer.
errors.targetDisabled: {label} is switched off in the settings.
errors.running: “{title}” is running. Stop the turn and continue on {label}?
errors.stillRunning: The turn did not stop, so nothing was handed over.
errors.createFailed: Could not start an agent on {label}: {error}. The current agent is untouched.
errors.busy: A move from this agent is already under way.
errors.operationGone: This operation is no longer known; open Ferry again to see where things are.
errors.deliveryMissing: This handoff is no longer on record.
errors.alreadyRead: This handoff already arrived; no retry needed.
errors.movedOn: The conversation has moved to another agent since, so this handoff is not sent again.
errors.retryFailed: The retry did not get through either: {error}

notes.startGuessed: Where stretch {visit} ({provider}) begins was inferred from what was already known.
notes.startUnknown: Could not find where stretch {visit} ({provider}) begins; everything read was included.
notes.visitUnreadable: Stretch {visit} could not be read and is left out: {error}
notes.thinkingFallback: The target model has no “{thinking}” thinking level; using its default.
notes.noModes: {label} has no permission modes to choose from and runs with its own defaults.
notes.deltaTooSmall: The {label} agent's context is nearly full, so a new agent is started instead.
notes.nothingMissed: Nothing happened while it was away; only your message is sent.
notes.partial: The history is longer than the budget: {selected} of {total} items go along; the rest are in the history tool and the record file.
notes.switchBackFailed: Could not switch back to the earlier agent ({error}); a new agent was started instead.
notes.reused: An agent on {label} already holds this session; it is used.
notes.restored: The earlier {label} agent came back with its own settings.
notes.nativeUnavailable: Native continuation is not possible here ({error}); handing over instead.
notes.nativeFailed: Native continuation failed ({error}); handing over instead.
notes.nativeArchives: With native continuation the previous agent is always archived: two agents must not write one session.
notes.nativeUnavailableHere: Native continuation is not available on this daemon; every provider gets a handoff.
notes.nativeOff: Native continuation is off in the settings; every provider gets a handoff.
notes.sameProviderNew: A new {label} agent with {model} takes over, with the history.
notes.backOtherModel: The earlier {label} agent uses {model}; a new agent starts with the model you chose.
notes.thinkingRefused: {label} did not take the thinking level {thinking} with this mode; it runs at its default.

warnings.running: This agent is running; you will be asked whether to stop the turn first.
warnings.modeEscalated: Every permission mode of the target is more permissive than the current one; using the most careful, “{mode}”.
warnings.sendFailed: The message was not sent: {error}. Retry from the row in the chat.
warnings.archiveFailed: The previous agent could not be archived ({error}); do not message both.
warnings.wrongProvider: The continued agent runs on {provider}, not the one expected.
warnings.otherWorkspace: The new agent landed in another workspace.

reasons.sameProviderNew: here now; a new agent with another model

settings.languageDescription: The language of Ferry's screens. Following the system, Chinese devices show Simplified Chinese and others English.
settings.intro: Move a conversation to another provider. These settings live on the host and apply to every device.
settings.partnersInfo: /ferry without arguments and the button shown on failure go straight to the partner.
settings.budgetHint: How much history a handoff carries at most; less when the target's context is small.
settings.toolOutputHint: The start and end of each command's output.
settings.defaultMessageHint: Sent when you write nothing; empty uses the built-in wording.
settings.afterHandoffHint: Native continuation always archives the previous agent.
settings.historyToolHint: Gives the agent that takes over a read-only tool for the history left out (needs Paseo's MCP tools for agents).
settings.transcriptFileHint: Each handoff writes the whole history (redacted) to a file and tells the agent where it is.
settings.nativeInfo: Providers on the same CLI that share a session store continue the very same session. Set a provider whose launcher uses a directory of its own to “not shared”.
settings.failurePillHint: After a failed turn the button says what went wrong, such as “Out of quota → partner”, and one press continues there.
settings.alertRowsHint: When a reply is itself a quota notice or a provider error, adds a row to the chat with a way to continue elsewhere.
settings.slashAliasHint: A second name besides /ferry, e.g. switch.
settings.deliveryInfo: History goes as an attachment the app does not show; for a provider that does not get attachments, put it in the message.
settings.dataInfo: Chains and handoff records are kept in the plugin's data folder on the host, readable only by you.
settings.forgetAllHint: Deletes every chain, history snapshot and record file. The conversations themselves are not touched.
settings.composerButtonHint: Shows “⇄ Ferry” next to every agent's composer: the partner in one step, or the picker. Off, a button appears only after a failed turn.
